input.command:
mkdir -p /home/maker/hook && cat > /tmp/claude-1000/-home-maker-hook/743ac2ad-e248-4781-ab9c-640f52e6e1af/scratchpad/block.py <<'EOF'
import FreeCAD, Part
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("Block")
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Block")
box.Length = 5
box.Width = 20
box.Height = 60
doc.recompute()
print("VOLUME_MM3", box.Shape.Volume)
doc.saveAs("/home/maker/hook/block.FCStd")
EOF
freecadcmd /tmp/claude-1000/-home-maker-hook/743ac2ad-e248-4781-ab9c-640f52e6e1af/scratchpad/block.py 2>&1 | tail -5; ls -l /home/maker/hook
